stem: A client with cancer is ambulatory and independently performs self-care but can no longer work and is up and active for more than half of each waking day. Which ECOG performance-status grade best matches this description?
rationale: C is correct. ECOG 2 is defined as ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out work activities, while being up and about for more than 50% of waking hours. ECOG 0 indicates full activity. ECOG 1 indicates restriction in strenuous activity while the person remains able to perform light or sedentary work. ECOG 3 indicates only limited self-care and confinement to bed or chair for more than 50% of waking hours. ECOG performance status describes functional impairment and is used clinically to characterize daily functioning; it does not replace the broader assessment.
educational_objective: Apply the ECOG Performance Status Scale by distinguishing ECOG 2 from adjacent grades using ambulation, self-care capacity, work ability, and time spent active during waking hours.
